g1.flow: Four surah openings. Az-Zumar 39:1 alone has no Ḥā Mīm before it; next, 'We sent down to you the Book in truth'. Ghāfir 40:2 alone ends al-ʿalīm (the Knowing); next, 'forgiver of sin'. Al-Jāthiyah 45:2 and Al-Aḥqāf 46:2 match word for word, so the next ayah decides: Al-Jāthiyah turns to signs for the believers, Al-Aḥqāf to creation 'in truth and a specified term'. Hook: ḥakīm, ʿalīm, ḥakīm, ḥakīm.

cues.39:1: Az-Zumar: first ayah, no Ḥā Mīm before; ends al-ḥakīm; next, 'sent down to you in truth'.
cues.40:2: Ghāfir: ends al-ʿalīm (the Knowing); next, 'forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance'.
cues.45:2: Al-Jāthiyah: ends al-ḥakīm; next, 'within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers'.
cues.46:2: Al-Aḥqāf: ends al-ḥakīm; next, heavens and earth created only in truth and for a specified term.
